name: Skill Creator
description: Use when the user asks to create a custom skill, turn a runbook or process into a reusable skill, import a skill from a repository or marketplace, port an existing skill to Hivy, or organize the team's skills into plugins. Guide the user through design or source review, adapt the workflow to Hivy, test it, obtain approval, and publish it for the calling agent's team.
human_description: Creates custom skills from scratch or imports existing ones.
